name: Link and Motivation Inc.
summary: Link and Motivation Inc. provides consulting and cloud services in Japan. The company operates through Development Division, Individual Development Division, and Matching Division segments. The company offers human capital management; motivation cloud, an HRTech (Human Resources x Technology) solution that helps resolve issues; and HR transformation services, including diagnostics and solutions covering all areas of recruitment, and training, and organizational. It also provides mid-career employee training, management training, training for young people, human resources recruitment services.
